systems.system: Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Module for Law Enforcement Agencies
systems.owner: Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC), under the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition
systems.tiers: real-time searches of company ownership by law enforcement agencies including SAPS, IDAC, the SIU and the NPA; upgraded version launched 29 September 2026, first launched April 2023

note: A company-registry search tool opened to SAPS and other agencies; it is the registrar's system, not a police record system, and nothing is said of how stations record.
